record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare GLAIVE_RUSH: Frigibax (1 star), Arctibax (2 stars) and Baxcalibur (3 stars), all range 1, maxPP 100, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (damage table index).
record.summary: The caster halves its own def and speDef for 6000 ms (armor reduction), then dashes to the closest free cell in the opposite end row of the board, swapping position without a forced-displacement check. Every enemy standing on a cell of the straight (supercover) path is collected before the move; each collected enemy gets armor reduction for 6000 ms and then SPECIAL damage (raw 50/100/200 by stars 1/2/3; 400 at 4 stars or fallback). If no enemy was on the path, or no free destination cell existed, the cast target is hit instead (only if no enemy was collected). After the move the caster cooldown is set to 100 ms.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the path cells from the caster's start cell to the destination; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: The cast target is hit only when the path contained no enemy (or there was no destination); an enemy path that does not include the original target leaves the target unhit.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the destination cell; cells read before the move
geometry.destination: closest empty cell (Manhattan distance, scan-order tie-break) to (caster column, destination row); destination row = last row for a RED_TEAM caster on rows 0-1 and for an other-team caster not on the last two rows, otherwise row 0 (BOARD_HEIGHT = 6)

effects.target: each enemy collected on the path (else the cast target)
effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); if the cast crit (only with ABILITY_CRIT since canCritByDefault is false) x 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor (Rocky Helmet cancels, Black Augurite reduces).
effects.resolution: armor reduction is applied to that enemy first, so the SPECIAL division uses speDef halved with Math.round (and def/speDef swapped under WONDER_ROOM); then an hp <= 0 or resurrecting target takes nothing; attacker-state multipliers apply first; flat reductions; at least 1; shield before HP; protect / skydiving / magicBounce block the hit. takenDamage includes shield damage. Each enemy is hit once per cast (a Set), even if the path crosses it twice.

declaredRaw.destination: closest free cell to (own column, far end row)

effects.resolution: moveTo(destination, forcedDisplacement false) swaps the caster with the (empty) destination cell, puts it in a moving state and sets its cooldown to 100 ms. If getClosestAvailablePlace returns null (no free cell) the caster does not move.

statusEffects.scaling: requested 6000 ms; applied = after status duration reductions of the caster (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, Odd Keystone -10% each) unless Rune Protect is active on the caster; an existing longer duration is kept
statusEffects.effect: def and speDef halved (Math.round) in handleDamage while it lasts

statusEffects.target: each collected enemy, before it takes damage
statusEffects.scaling: requested 6000 ms; blocked if the enemy has Rune Protect; the duration reductions are read from the caster (second argument of the call), not from the enemy; an existing longer duration is kept
statusEffects.effect: def and speDef halved (Math.round) in handleDamage while it lasts, including for this ability's own damage

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (400) is not used by these units at factory values. The armor-reduction duration, path and destination do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Destination depends on team and current row (see geometry); the path is read before the move, so entities that are on the line when the cast starts are the ones collected.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes; each cast recomputes destination and path from the current board. Repeated armor reduction only lengthens the existing duration.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 50 / 100 / 200 SPECIAL per collected enemy; armor reduction 6000 ms on self and on each hit enemy. Requested damage = raw; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor if the cast crit), divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x (halved speDef because the enemy was just armor-reduced), minus flat reductions, minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Requested armor-reduction duration = 6000 ms; applied after duration reductions and Rune Protect. Not computed for a specific board.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, resurrection, other field multipliers); the armor-reduction halving, attacker-state multiplier block, SPECIAL defence division, non-TRUE flat reductions and the minimum of 1 were located
Crit resolution beyond the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the handleSpecialDamage multiplier
What the caster's moving state does after moveTo (toMovingState was not read) and how a 100 ms cooldown interacts with the next attack
Whether skydiving or otherwise untargetable entities appear as cell values on the path (only the team filter was read)
unresolved: Whether moving through cells occupied by allies or by entities that cannot be moved matters: the move is a swap with an empty destination only, path cells are only read
Tie-break among equally near free cells follows scan order (row by row, left to right) per the sort of the candidate list; the stability of that sort was not examined beyond the language guarantee
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
